observations: Black adult sport bicycle with a 'MANTY' brand logo on the down tube.
Double gear system visible on the rear derailleur.
Tire tread appears to be in good condition.
The bike is parked outdoors on a tiled surface.

claims.claim: Bought new 6 months ago. Gears and brakes perfect, no rust, all parts original.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The drivetrain may be seized or have internal gear damage.
risks.proof: A video showing the bike being pedaled and the gears shifting through all speeds.

risks.risk: The rear derailleur may be stripped or have a broken cable.
risks.proof: A video showing the derailleur moving through the gears.

risks.risk: The brakes may be non-functional or have worn pads.
risks.proof: A video showing the brakes being applied and the wheel locking.

risks.risk: The front suspension may be damaged or stiff.
risks.proof: A video showing the front fork compressing and releasing.

risks.risk: The rear wheel may have hidden cracks or flats.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the rear wheel with the tire removed.

proof_requests: Video of the bike being pedaled to demonstrate the gear shifting and drivetrain function.
Video of the brakes being applied and the wheel locking.
Close-up photo of the rear wheel with the tire removed to check for cracks or damage.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
